preconditions.description: The integer n must satisfy 2 ≤ n ≤ 300,000.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()[1:1+n]) == n and all(1 <= int(w) <= 10**12 for w in stdin.split()[1:1+n])
preconditions.description: The first line after n contains exactly n integers w_{1,2}, w_{3,4}, ..., w_{2n-1,2n}, each between 1 and 10^12.

preconditions.expression: n - 1 == sum(1 for _ in stdin.split()[1+n:].split() if _ == '\n')
preconditions.description: There are exactly n-1 lines describing edges between odd and even vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 4 for line in stdin.split()[1+n:].split('\n') if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Each of the n-1 lines contains exactly four integers: x_i, y_i, w_{i,1}, w_{i,2}.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n and int(x) != int(y) for line in stdin.split()[1+n:].split('\n') if line.strip() for x, y, _, _ in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: For each edge line, x_i and y_i are distinct integers between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(w) <= 10**12 for line in stdin.split()[1+n:].split('\n') if line.strip() for _, _, w1, w2 in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: For each edge line, w_{i,1} and w_{i,2} are integers between 1 and 10^12.
The number of queries q satisfies 1 ≤ q ≤ 600,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(u) <= 2 * int(stdin.split()[0]) and 1 <= int(v) <= 2 * int(stdin.split()[0]) and int(u) != int(v) for line in stdin.split()[1+n + (n-1) + 2:].split('\n') if line.strip() for u, v in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each query contains two distinct integers u_i and v_i between 1 and 2n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(str(compute_shortest_path(u, v, n, w_odd_even, w_odd_odd, w_even_even)) for u, v in queries) + '\n'
postconditions.description: For each query (u_i, v_i), the output must be the length of the shortest path between u_i and v_i in the graph, computed as the minimum sum of edge weights along any simple path from u_i to v_i.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(answer) <= 10**12 * (2 * n - 1) for answer in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each answer is a positive integer representing a valid path length, bounded by the maximum possible sum of edge weights.
